sql.if: AND ( bj.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR bj.branch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR bj.job_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.git_repo LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql: FROM build_job bj LEFT JOIN service s ON s.id = bj.service_id LEFT JOIN env e ON e.id = bj.env_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = bj.creator_id
